notes.title: v1.10.8 - Coins are now capped at 999,999,999
notes.content:
Coins are now capped at 999,999,999.
Fixed an issue where the upgraded "Purification Potion" gave the wrong amount of coins.

notes.title: v1.10.6 - The coin drop from Stone Giant has been increased by 1.
notes.content:
The coin drop from Stone Giant has been increased by 1.
The target coin amount for Years 19 and 24 has been increased by 2.
Fixed an issue where some texts were displayed incorrectly.

notes.title: v1.10.5 – 5 New Spirits Added!
notes.content:
Added 5 new spirits.
Updated the upgraded effect of the skill card "Bomb".
Adjusted the value requirement of the skill card "Clown Mask".
Spirit rewards can now be skipped.
Skill cards that apply curses can now activate without an empty slot if their durability is 1.
Fixed a bug where Ebon Dragon could silence other monsters.
